why: SCC-417 revert-proof. Code-derived: each mutant flips ONE decision in the two widened _BANNED_PATTERNS entries and must die by the case that pins that decision alone. M1 = NARROW the your-call entry back to the forward order (the SCC-416 defect, half of it). M2 = NARROW it back to the singular (the other half). M3 = DELETE the cross-repo entry (the shape no entry knew). M4 = WIDEN the cross-repo entry by dropping the scoped case-sensitivity, so 'its own two tickets' matches. M5 = WIDEN the reversed arm's window from 40 to 400 characters, so an honest landing-order row 85 characters wide matches. M1-M3 are killed by the B11 single-shape pins; M4 and M5 by the B12 near-miss pins - a widening that no near-miss can see is a widening nobody measured.

mutants.original:
(re.compile(r"\b(?:its|their)\s+own\s+(?-i:[A-Z]{2,10})\s+tickets?\b", re.I),
     "files this work as another board's tickets"),
